reader_summary.headline: Rick Heitzmann is the founder and Managing Partner of FirstMark Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Rick Heitzmann is the founder and Managing Partner of FirstMark Capital. some of FirstMark's past wins include Pinterest, DraftKings, Shopify, Upwork, StubHub, and Airbnb. Rick is a one-man treasure trove of venture insights. Our conversation includes his background across distressed investing, operations, and growth capital, the New York tech scene.
